title: P1: Main Chat spec — 8 completeness gaps
description: 1. No Chat/set destroy semantics. 2. No Space/leave mechanism. 3. deliveryState transitions undefined. 4. Channel Chats not forbidden in Chat/set create. 5. send/view permissions never normatively enforced at method level. 6. hasMention filter ignores broadcast mentions targeting owner. 7. SpaceRole.color type mismatch in addRoles (String-only vs 3-format). 8. Message/set create lacks explicit membership/permission check.
